title: Sky: Meeting the Goals of the Paris Agreement
notes: Not on Shell's current archive page; PDF retrieved from the Wayback Machine (original shell.com URL now 404). Date from the booklet's cautionary note (26 March 2018). Energy quantities are in charts only; text values captured.

entries.label: Sky
entries.quote: Limiting warming in line with the Paris Agreement means achieving net-zero emissions by 2070, just over 50 years from now.
entries.subject: energy system
electric vehicles
entries.metric: passenger EV cost parity with combustion engine cars
entries.quote: In Sky, passenger electric vehicles reach cost parity with combustion engine cars by 2025.

entries.subject: CO2 emissions
entries.quote: Energy system CO2 emissions peak in the mid-2020s at around 35 gigatonnes (Gt), after which a continuous decline sets in.

entries.subject: coal
entries.metric: coal's share of global primary energy
entries.quote: By 2070, coal’s share of global primary energy falls to around 6%, down from 25% in 2020.

entries.subject: nuclear power
entries.quote: In Sky, nuclear power grows steadily, with 1,400 GW of capacity by 2070, up from 450 GW in 2020.

entries.subject: carbon capture and storage
entries.quote: Some 10,000 large carbon capture and storage facilities are built, compared to fewer than 50 in operation in 2020.
